title: Bundled Child Playing, Winter Snow Yard - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An endearing vintage horizontal snapshot showing a young toddler or small child bundled up in warm winter attire outdoors. The child wears a dark jacket, light trousers, dark boots or galoshes, a light-colored winter cap, and a long dark patterned scarf, standing playfully in a snow-covered yard with bare winter trees visible in the background.
